notes:
• New offer flow: customer name → 📠 Scan cards → ⚡ Send to CardUploader → export the CSV in CardUploader. The app watches Downloads, moves the CardUploader file into the offer's folder with the scans, and loads it into the offer by itself
• Several games in one offer: pick the Game on the Scan tab — each game gets its own scan folder, and every CardUploader file adds to the same offer
• Send checks CardUploader's Database matches the game (picks it when it can, otherwise waits for you to switch it)
